summary: Native Android release 0.5.15 (versionCode 17): renders Switchboard's stored system rows (a session link's Not delivered row with Send, profile and agent switches, handoffs, peer sends, approval results) instead of an 'Unsupported event' card. automated: mobile-release.yml runs the Android unit and lint gate and verifies package, signer fingerprint and checksum, and a version higher than the newest published APK when one exists (the monotonic check is skipped when no earlier APK asset is found), before it publishes.
